methodology: Own parser, range coverage, native-row identity, occupancy and896 top2 recomputations; did not import author audit/allocator functions or execute author script. No routes, weights or VM accessed; no author file modified.

original_allocator_reconstruction.rule: A short stream that would cross an extra block is advanced to the next block; this is our minimum-command/cold-run policy, not an AiF paper requirement.

capacity_bounds.proof: Every intact112-wave GU needs a separate192-wave block; pairingGU112+down56 attains256. Allowing row-safe GU splits attains the43008/192=224 volume bound.
capacity_bounds.command_bound_conditions: Same four-plane-wave-aligned layout family and unchanged NAND waves;224 completely filled block stripes;256 complete down streams stay unsplit;GU segments are disjoint complete rows and may occupy arbitrary block holes. A connected GU/block component balances112*k=192*b-56*d, forcing b divisible by7. Thus at most32 components; GU edges>=256+224-32=448, plus256 down commands.

separate_gate_up_template.interpretation: Same physical addresses, additionally end native operations at the separate gate/up boundary; no fusion hardware is required for the capacity bound. Not claimed to minimize separate-projection commands.

author710.assumptions: 250ns/native command; full4096B input reload at2B/ns per shared channel; no extra PCIe; not calibrated hardware

independent704.assumptions: 250ns/native command; full4096B input reload at2B/ns per shared channel; no extra PCIe; not calibrated hardware

command_cost_audit.verdict: 704 minimizes inventory commands under stated down-intact restriction, but concentrates splits on experts6/7 each layer and has worse worst-case routed cost. It does not latency-dominate author710; neither cost is hardware calibrated.

primary_evidence.title: AiF, ISCA2025
primary_evidence.read_depth: Original supplied paper §4.1/§4.4/§5.2 and printedp538 footnotes8-9 checked.
primary_evidence.evidence: aif_post evenly shards and sequentially places submatrices in IFP blocks; controller locates their addresses. Footnote9 explicitly dispatches multiple GEMV operations when a submatrix spans IFP blocks. The paper does not disclose this repo no-extra-crossing policy or a321block baseline.
primary_evidence.limitation: Does not establish exact short-matrix cohabitation or controller run-list policy. Do not assert published implementation actually used224 blocks.

primary_evidence.title: Cambricon-LLM, MICRO2024 preprint
primary_evidence.evidence: Hardware-aware matrix tiling with page-sized atomic tiles and equal compute-core mapping is prior.
primary_evidence.limitation: Different chiplet architecture; not proof of AiF free-block interface or this exact capacity count.

primary_evidence.title: FlashAccel, arXiv2026 v2
primary_evidence.evidence: Sequentially packs operator weight chunks across consecutive hyperpages and continues subsequent operators at the next available location.
primary_evidence.limitation: Custom HBF geometry, not an AiF implementation; supports lack of novelty in generic cross-operator dense packing only.

implementation_corrections_that_can_be_c: This repository minimum-command allocator over-reserves Mixtral IFP LSB stripes:321/chip versus256 with generic whole-stream order and224 with existing native row-GEMV segmentation.
The serialized224plan has exact one-copy row coverage and no physical overlap; no output partial sum, precision change, new decoder, new PE operation or retained accumulator is needed.
A controller software allocator/run map can issue existing block/offset/page-count GEMVs and concatenate complete rows. This is a design certificate, not implemented numerical hardware.
Use a strong capacity-versus-native-command Pareto baseline:256blocks with unchanged commands;224 with paid row-safe segmentation. Include existing equalg16 ownership, not only the learned layout.
claims_not_supported: 30.218% capacity gain over AiF/SOTA.321blocks is our own restrictive policy, so this comparison is only a local implementation correction.
A new MoE/coactivation-aware physical placement algorithm. The construction uses dimensions only and ordinary dense packing.
A normal-read NAND latency gain. Pages and read waves are unchanged; split runs add control/input work.
aif_post already exposes arbitrary physical addresses or the current metadata-only timing kernel implements the new physical mapping.
The author710command plan is universally command-minimal or latency-optimal.
Publication novelty from row-safe block splitting, first-fit-decreasing, a wave-volume capacity bound, or simple output-row concatenation.
baseline_adjustments_required: Retire321blocks as a strong ordinary-read capacity baseline. Keep it only as explicitly labeled legacy/minimum-command allocator.
For fixed-command comparisons use256blocks/chip, attainable by both expert-first order and FFD.

For capacity comparisons allow224blocks/chip with existing native block split and all incurred metadata/control/input costs. Do not preclude block crossings solely to preserve CR runs in a noCR study.

Recompute any capacity-budget/redudancy or reliability result whose budget was based on321 versus224/256. Which duty model is used matters: compacting holes can increase disturbance stress, as shown in the separate oracle.
Preserve distinction between read-work lower bound and reserved capacity. Empty suffix slots were never read, so reclaiming them cannot speed up dense NAND service.
Retain source-paper/controller uncertainty.224 is an existing-operation constructive baseline, not proof of the original authors undisclosed allocator.
model_label_caveat: packing.json labels6.4 bytes/ns as ecc_mac_ceiling; AiF publishes ECCLITE throughput/internal bandwidth but does not disclose MAC lane throughput. Ordinary28us read waves dominate this timing ceiling here; capacity/row proofs do not use a MAC assumption.
unverified_deployment_requirements: Controller run-list lookup, allocation and output concatenation implementation and cost.
